# Example callback bodies (supervisor_daily_summary)

All three are what the AI service POSTs to `/api/v1/internal/ai/results`.

- `supervisor-callback.example.json`: a normal AI report. Generated by the real model from `fixtures/supervisor_daily_summary/happy.json`-style
  data (45 present of 50, 130 units vs 120, 95 gifts of 100) and checked by hand. `insights` is optional provenance.
- `supervisor-callback.fallback.example.json`: the same report shape when the model failed. Note `confidence: 0`, the
  `@deterministic-fallback@` model version and `output.fallback`. It is a normal report: store and show it.
  (In a real fallback the text is the deterministic template, not the model's; only the shape is the point here.)
- `supervisor-callback.needs-data.example.json`: `output.error` is used only for `NEEDS_DATA` and `PII_FIREWALL`.
